title: HINT for Customer Support — answers follow policy
metaDescription: Keep approved answers, entitlement, verification and escalation rules beside support playbooks so assistants do not invent fixes or promises.
h1: Your assistant replies fast. HINT keeps every answer inside support policy.
intro: HINT keeps approved answers, entitlement rules, verification steps and escalation paths in plain-text notes beside support playbooks. Your assistant reads the rules for this product and customer context before replying.

situations.before: A response promises a refund or feature outside the customer's entitlement.
situations.body: The assistant sees tier and entitlement limits before offering a remedy.

situations.before: Sensitive account details are disclosed before identity is checked.
situations.body: Required verification steps precede any action or information covered by the policy.

situations.before: A difficult case receives a confident invented ETA.
situations.body: The assistant states what is known and follows the declared escalation path without making a timing promise.

example.intro: The Vandelay Support demo grounds a LaTeX-product answer in an approved source.
example.after: It replies from the approved playbook, verifies required facts, and escalates when policy does not supply an answer.
example.compiled:
<answer name="latex-1">
  Approved answer grounded in SRC-1.
</answer>
<never name="Invented details">…</never>

never: Promise a remedy, feature or ETA outside declared policy.
Disclose protected information before required verification.
Invent a troubleshooting result or silently skip escalation.
disclaimer: HINT governs answer content; your helpdesk, identity controls, service policies and authorized support processes remain authoritative.

faq.q: Does it integrate with a helpdesk?
faq.a: HINT governs the files and context behind an answer; your existing tools handle tickets and delivery.

faq.q: Can it work in live chat?
faq.a: Yes, when the assistant handling the chat can run HINT or receive its context through MCP.

faq.q: Can policies vary by locale or tier?
faq.a: Yes. Put narrower rules in the relevant product, locale or tier folder so they apply only there.

keywordDescriptions.product: Sets the product whose support rules apply.
keywordDescriptions.intent: Names the customer's confirmed reason for contact.
keywordDescriptions.answer: Records approved response content and its conditions.
keywordDescriptions.entitlement: Defines what the customer's tier permits.
keywordDescriptions.verify: Lists checks required before an action or disclosure.
keywordDescriptions.refund: Defines an authorized refund condition and limit.
keywordDescriptions.identify: Sets required identity checks before disclosure.
keywordDescriptions.escalate: Defines when and where the case must be handed off.
